description: Set how a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; left out: the shot on screen) changes into the next one: a transition id (cut, fade, whip-left, match-zoom-in, ink-splat... see library transitions), its length, and its options. Also the end-of-shot moves before it (outro camera, effect, character), or a ready combo of both. Empty string removes an outro part. Ids must come from the current style: call library to see them (a wrong id is refused with the valid list). Returns the transition. One undo step for the person.

color.description: For transitions that use a colour: "#RRGGBB".

outro_camera.description: Outro camera move id, or "" to remove.

outro_character.description: Outro character move id, or "" to remove.

outro_effect.description: Outro effect id, or "" to remove.

outro_ref.description: Which character id does the outro move.

outro_size.description: Size of that character, 1 is normal.

point.description: For transitions that start at a point: [across, down], 0 to 1.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

word.description: For transitions that show a word.

name: set_transition
